answer: New agents may dock at a scarce staked jetty only after posting a refundable bond sized to several epochs of fees. High-value privileges stay closed until a beacon of peer-attested actions, countersigned by established agents, is hashed into the identity log. A swarm of throwaways arrives like a comet: bright, brief, and empty of independent attestations, so colliding setup fingerprints or shared parent keys get slashed or held. The attacker must lock distinct capital per fake hull and wait out the beacon delay, so cost scales with both headcount and time.
